```c
#include <stdio.h>
int main(void) {
    printf("HelloCHighlight");
    return 0;
}
```

```c:interactive
#include <stdio.h>
int main(void) {
    printf("HelloCInteractive");
    return 0;
}
```

```python

    print("HelloPyHighlight")
main()
```

    print("HelloPyInteractive")
